purpose: Measure whether the skill is selected, independently from review quality.
selection_rule: product-level judgment, adversarial testing, cross-surface product-documentation consistency, release decision, re-review, or artifact-grounded defense intent selects the skill even when target presence is uncertain; the artifact gate then requires one real review target

cases.prompt: Audit our internal API-key guide, llms.txt, and public /api-keys/docs for factual contradictions before launch. List every concrete issue in plain language.
我用 Cursor 两天做了这个支付 App，别教我基础知识，按 Staff 标准挑刺，看现在敢不敢收真钱。
Rate my app as a Staff engineer. I have not attached a repository or deployment, and this workspace may be empty.
Be a hostile first-time user and try to break signup, checkout, account recovery, and cancellation on this deployment.
At strict-review depth, pretend you're a skeptical VC. Review the demo, usage CSV, and repo; separate what is proven from founder claims and score the product.
I fixed the blockers from your last audit. Re-run the same rubric, retest the flows, and show the score delta.

At strict-review depth, act as an oral-defense examiner and interview me one question at a time about why this AI-generated app is safe under retries and concurrent requests; base the questions on its code.
As a Staff Frontend engineer, audit this deployed dashboard for browser-state bugs, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, and interaction quality before public launch.
Roast my Lovable prototype, but make every criticism reproducible and turn the top findings into implementation prompts.
这个 App 已经写完了。按严格评审深度让我参加答辩：问我它最可能怎么死，答完再分别给产品和我的理解打分。
Review this 20-line function for naming, complexity, and idiomatic TypeScript.
The checkout test fails with ECONNRESET. Debug it and patch the bug.
Explain ACID and HTTP statelessness to me like I'm a junior backend developer.
Act as a Staff engineer and review my psychology essay.
cases.reason: persona keyword but no software product

cases.prompt: Run a mock Staff backend interview and ask me distributed-systems questions.
cases.reason: job interview rather than product defense

cases.prompt: Help me write a VC pitch deck for an idea; I do not have a prototype, product evidence, or users yet.

cases.prompt: Create a QA test plan for signup and checkout; do not inspect or score the current app.

cases.prompt: Assess whether this public company is investable from its annual report and market valuation.
cases.reason: financial due diligence rather than a built-product review

cases.prompt: Rewrite these three API-key docs so their tone, capitalization, and headings match. Do not audit product behavior or issue a release verdict.
cases.reason: purely stylistic copy editing rather than product-contract consistency audit
